v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Assúmpta est María in cælum: * gaudent Angeli, laudántes benedícunt Dóminum.
text.en: Mary hath been taken to heaven; * the Angels rejoice; they praise and bless the Lord.

text.la: María Virgo assúmpta est * ad æthéreum thálamum, in quo Rex regum stelláto sedet sólio.
text.en: The Virgin Mary hath been taken into the chamber on high, * where the King of kings sitteth on a throne amid the stars.

text.la: In odórem * unguentórum tuórum cúrrimus: adolescéntulæ dilexérunt te nimis.
text.en: We run after thee, on the scent of thy perfumes * the virgins love thee heartily.

text.la: Benedícta * fília tu a Dómino: quia per te fructum vitæ communicávimus.
text.en: Blessed of the Lord art thou, O daughter, * for by thee we have been given to eat of the fruit (of the tree) of Life.

text.la: Pulchra es * et decóra, fília Ierúsalem, terríbilis ut castrórum ácies ordináta.
text.en: Fair and comely art thou, O daughter of Jerusalem, * terrible as a fenced camp set in battle array.

text.la: Benedíxit te Dóminus in virtúte sua, quia per te ad níhilum redégit inimícos nostros. Benedícta es tu, fília, a Dómino Deo excélso, præ ómnibus muliéribus super terram.
text.en: The Lord hath blessed thee by his power, because by thee he hath brought our enemies to nought. Blessed art thou, O daughter, by the Lord the most high God, above all women upon the earth.

v.en: The holy Mother of God hath been exalted.

r.la: Super choros Angelórum ad cæléstia regna.
r.en: Over choirs of Angels, into the heavenly kingdom.

text.la: Quæ est ista * quæ ascéndit sicut auróra consúrgens, pulchra ut luna, elécta ut sol, terríbilis ut castrórum ácies ordináta?
text.en: Who is she * that cometh up like the rising dawn, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, terrible as a fenced camp set in battle array?

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui Immaculátam Vírginem Maríam, Fílii tui Genetrícem, córpore et ánima ad cæléstem glóriam assumpsísti: concéde, quǽsumus; ut ad supérna semper inténti, ipsíus glóriæ mereámur esse consórtes.
text.en: Almighty everlasting God, who hast taken body and soul into heaven the Immaculate Virgin Mary, Mother of thy Son: grant, we beseech thee, that by steadfastly keeping heaven as our goal we may be counted worthy to join her in glory.

title.la: Dominica XIII Post Pentecosten III. Augusti
title.en: Dominica XIII Post Pentecosten III. Augusti

text.la: Cum transíret Iesus quoddam castéllum, occurrérunt ei decem viri leprósi, qui stetérunt a longe et levavérunt vocem dicéntes: Iesu præcéptor, miserére nostri.
text.en: As Jesus passed through a certain village, there met Him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off; and they lifted up their voices, and said: “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.”

v.en: The Lord reigns, he is clothed with beauty.

r.la: Índuit Dóminus fortitúdinem, et præcínxit se virtúte.
r.en: The Lord is clothed with strength, and has girded Himself with power.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, da nobis fídei, spei et caritátis augméntum: et, ut mereámur ássequi quod promíttis, fac nos amáre quod prǽcipis.
text.en: Almighty and everlasting God, give unto us the increase of faith, hope, and charity, and that we may worthily obtain that which Thou dost promise, make us to love that which Thou dost command.
